shortTitle: SOFC Energy Optimization for AI Data Centers
summary: A new NTU-Delta Electronics Innovation Research Funding project on how to power energy-hungry AI data centers with solid oxide fuel cells (SOFC). It builds a multi-objective optimization framework that sizes and dispatches an integrated SOFC + solar-PV + storage + grid system — with hydrogen/natural-gas fuel blending and waste-heat-driven cooling — to trade off lifecycle cost, carbon emissions, and supply reliability, and to chart a low-carbon transition pathway under different carbon-pricing scenarios. Led by the E3 Center in collaboration with Delta Electronics.
summaryZh: 全新之國立臺灣大學台達電子創新研究基金計畫，探討如何以固態氧化物燃料電池（SOFC）為高耗能的 AI 資料中心供電。計畫建立多目標最佳化框架，對整合 SOFC、太陽光電、儲能與電網的系統進行容量配置與調度——並納入氫氣／天然氣混摻燃料與廢熱驅動之冷卻——以權衡生命週期成本、碳排放與供電穩定性，並在不同碳定價情境下勾勒低碳轉型路徑。由 E3 中心主持，並與台達電子合作。
